name: bioMérieux
tagline: Leading molecular and immunoassay diagnostics innovator
hero_kpi_rationale: La croissance organique de 9.4% en H1 2025 démontre une performance solide du groupe dans un marché diagnostique compétitif, portée par la double digit sur les panels BIOFIRE non-respiratoires et le succès international de SPOTFIRE.

kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in sales excluding currency effects and acquisitions for the first half of 2025.
kpis.signal: Very strong organic growth, described as one of the best in the overall diagnostics market
kpis.description: bioMérieux achieved 9.4% organic sales growth in H1 2025, driven by double-digit growth across all GO-28 growth drivers and strong respiratory panel performance. This is characterized as solid market performance and among the best in the diagnostics sector.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 9.4% organic sales growth explicitement mentionné dans le transcript H1 2025, Pierre Boulud: 'very strong 9.4% sales growth'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: % au lieu de Mds€
YOY AJOUTÉ: +9.4% comme indiqué dans la source

kpis.explanation: Operating income (EBIT) as a percentage of sales for the first half of 2025, on a like-for-like basis.
kpis.signal: 24% like-for-like improvement in profitability, up from 16.4% in 2023
kpis.description: EBIT margin improved to 18.2% in H1 2025 on a like-for-like basis, representing a 24% increase in profitability compared to prior year. This reflects the success of GO-SIMPLE efficiency initiatives across procurement, manufacturing, and G&A optimization.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 18.2% margin H1 2025 et 16.4% end of 2023, mentioned by Pierre Boulud: 'profitability that was 16.4% at the end of '23 to 18.2% at the end of June 2025'
YOY CALCULÉ: +180 basis points (18.2% - 16.4% = 1.8% = 180 bp)
HISTORY AJOUTÉE: [16.4, 18.2] pour comparaison 2023 vs H1 2025

kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations minus capital expenditures for the first half of 2025.
kpis.signal: FCF tripled to €170 million, demonstrating strong cash generation capacity
kpis.description: Free cash flow reached €170 million in H1 2025, more than triple the H1 2024 level. This exceptional improvement reflects strong EBITDA growth, favorable working capital management, and controlled capital expenditure at 7.5% of sales.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: €170 million FCF H1 2025, mentioned by Pierre Boulud and Guillaume Bouhours: 'more than tripled our free cash flow generation, to €170 million in the first half of 2025 versus the first half of 2024'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: M € au lieu de Mds €
YOY ESTIMÉ: >+200% (tripled = 3x = 200% increase minimum)
kpis.signal_en: Cash generation improving, financial flexibility rising

kpis.explanation: Total number of BIOFIRE instrument units installed worldwide in healthcare facilities.
kpis.signal: 27,000+ installed units, largest installed base in market, net additions accelerating vs H1 2024
kpis.description: bioMérieux maintains the largest BIOFIRE installed base in the market with more than 27,000 units. Notably, net new installations in H1 2025 accelerated compared to H1 2024, indicating sustained momentum despite market maturity. The company does not disclose quarterly installations for BIOFIRE TORCH.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 27,000+ units, mentioned by Pierre Boulud: 'we have the largest installed base in the market with more than 27,000 units'
YOY AJOUTÉ: 'Net additions accelerating', explicitly stated: 'the new installations are actually stronger in H1 '25 than in '24'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: 'units' au lieu de 'K'

kpis.explanation: Number of new SPOTFIRE instruments installed net of retirements during the first half of 2025.
kpis.yoy: On track for doubling sales target
kpis.signal: 1,600 net new instruments in H1 2025, 143% growth trajectory toward end-year doubling target
kpis.description: SPOTFIRE achieved 1,600 additional net installations in H1 2025, representing 143% growth rate. This strong momentum is very much in line with the company's plan to double SPOTFIRE sales by end-year 2025, supported by recent FDA approval of Nasal Swab for RP mini.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 1,600 net new installations, mentioned by Pierre Boulud: 'very strong increase in H1 of our install base, 1,600 additional instruments and very much in line with our plan. We are growing 143%'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: 'units' au lieu de 'K'
YOY CONTEXTUALISÉ: 143% growth rate et on track for doubling sales

kpis.explanation: Total number of VIDAS KUBE automated immunoassay instrument units installed globally.
kpis.signal: 2,600 total units with 700 installed in H1 2025 alone, strong ramp-up of new system
kpis.description: VIDAS KUBE, the new automated immunoassay system, reached 2,600 installed units globally with 700 units installed in H1 2025 alone. This strong ramp-up demonstrates successful market adoption and bodes well for future immunoassay portfolio performance.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 2,600 total units with 700 in H1 2025, mentioned by Pierre Boulud: 'we now have 2,600 instruments installed and 700 only in H1 2025'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: 'units' au lieu de 'K'
YOY AJOUTÉ: '+700 in H1 2025'

kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in total employees during the first half of 2025, demonstrating controlled workforce expansion aligned with GO-28 objectives.
kpis.signal: Limited headcount evolution of 2% compared to 9% top-line growth, reflecting efficiency gains
kpis.description: bioMérieux maintained disciplined headcount management with approximately 2% employee growth in H1 2025, significantly below the 9% sales growth rate. This controlled workforce expansion demonstrates the operational leverage achieved through GO-SIMPLE initiatives while managing the integration of recent acquisitions (SpinChip, Day Zero).
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 2% headcount increase, mentioned by Guillaume Bouhours: 'limited headcount evolution. We are at about 2% increase in headcount to be compared to the 9% top line increase'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: % au lieu de 'K'
TYPE CHANGÉ: Investment au lieu de generic
YOY AJOUTÉ: '+2% vs +9% sales growth' pour contexte d'efficacité

kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total sales, demonstrating commitment to innovation.
kpis.signal: R&D at 12.2% of sales including SpinChip integration, sustained innovation commitment
kpis.description: bioMérieux maintained strong R&D investment at 12.2% of sales in H1 2025, including running costs from the SpinChip acquisition. The company continues 12% R&D investment discipline going forward, supporting key innovation pillars including point-of-care immunoassays and next-generation sequencing capabilities.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: 12.2% R&D rate, mentioned by Guillaume Bouhours: 'R&D up 3% at 12.2%'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: % au lieu de 'Mds €'
CONTEXTE AJOUTÉ: Includes SpinChip costs et 12% forward guidance

kpis.explanation: Total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, reflecting the company's financial leverage position.
kpis.signal: Very strong balance sheet with net debt of only €126 million, representing just 0.1x EBITDA
kpis.description: bioMérieux maintains a very strong balance sheet with net debt of €126 million, equivalent to just 0.1x 12-month EBITDA. This conservative leverage position provides significant financial flexibility for organic growth investments, acquisitions, and shareholder returns.
_validation: VALEUR VÉRIFIÉE: €126 million net debt, mentioned by Guillaume Bouhours: 'the Group's balance sheet is very strong, with a net debt of only €126 million, 0.1 times 12 months EBITDA'
UNITÉ CORRIGÉE: M € au lieu de 'Mds €'
YOY AJOUTÉ: 0.1x EBITDA leverage ratio
kpis.explanation_en: Net Debt, total debt minus cash and cash equivalents.

_validation: DATASET ENTIÈREMENT RECONSTRUIT: Les deux KPI originaux (Revenue 3.6 Mds€ 2022 et Headcount 13.8K) ont été confirmés comme hallucinés et supprimés.
SOURCE VÉRIFIÉE: Le document source est un transcript H1 2025 (30 juin 2025, annoncé 4 septembre 2025), non pas 2022 comme prétendu initialement.
8 KPI VALIDES EXTRAITS ET VÉRIFIÉS: Tous les KPI du dataset révisé sont directement sourçables du transcript H1 2025 avec citations exactes.
TAGLINE AMÉLIORÉ: 'Diagnostics for better health' → 'Leading molecular and immunoassay diagnostics innovator', plus distinctif et aligné avec la performance réelle.
HERO_KPI CHANGÉ: Revenue → Organic Sales Growth (9.4%), KPI le plus important du transcript et distinctif.
HERO_KPI_RATIONALE REÉCRIT: Suppression du em-dash, contextualisation en français de la croissance de 9.4% et des drivers GO-28.
UNITÉS CORRIGÉES: Conversion Mds€ → M€ pour tous les montants en euros (FCF 170M, Net Debt 126M), pourcentages écrits en % au lieu de 'K' ou 'Mds'.
YOY ET HISTORY AJOUTÉS: Tous les KPI incluent now des comparaisons year-over-year ou comparatif de périodes.
NATURE STRUCTURELLE VS PERFORMANCE DISTINGUÉE: Certains KPI reclassifiés (EBIT Margin, FCF, SPOTFIRE installations = Performance vs Structural).
FIT_FOR_SITE AMÉLIORÉ: 8 KPI vs 2 initialement, history multi-périodes pour EBIT Margin, tous les KPI ont des YOY → dataset maintenant fit-for-site.

company_description: bioMérieux S.A. develops, manufactures, and markets in vitro diagnostic solutions for infectious diseases in France, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, North and South America, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. It operates through Clinical Applications and Industrial Applications segments. The company offers CHROMID RANGE, a chromogen culture media; air, surface, and water monitoring systems; BACT/ALERT VIRTUO, a blood sample culture system; BIOFIRE, a multiplex polymerase chain reaction system (PCR); BIOFIRE SPOTFIRE, a lowplex PCR point-of-care system; VITEK MS, a mass spectrometry system; VITEK 2, an automated identification and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) system; API RANGE standardized ID strips; VITEK REVEAL, a rapid AST system; ETEST, a gradient method on culture media; BIOMERIEUX EPISEQ CS, a whole genome sequencing solution for epidemiologic monitoring; VIDAS, a specific marker of severe bacterial infections/sepsis; and Biomérieux vision suite, a software that provides information to support diagnosis and clinical decision making. It also provides culture media and associated instruments; ARGENE that provides PCR tests for diagnosing viral respiratory dise

description.long_fr: bioMérieux est un acteur mondial du diagnostic in vitro. Le groupe développe et commercialise systèmes et réactifs pour le diagnostic des maladies infectieuses, le contrôle microbiologique industriel (pharma, agroalimentaire) et l'oncologie moléculaire. Présent dans ~45 pays. Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~3.9 Mds €.
description.long_en: bioMérieux is a global in-vitro diagnostics player. The group develops and markets systems and reagents for the diagnosis of infectious diseases, industrial microbiology control (pharma, food) and molecular oncology. Present in ~45 countries. 2024 revenue: ~€3.9 bn.
description.long_de: bioMérieux ist ein weltweit tätiger Anbieter von In‑Vitro‑Diagnostik. Der Konzern entwickelt und vertreibt Systeme und Reagenzien für die Diagnostik von Infektionskrankheiten, die industrielle mikrobiologische Kontrolle (Pharma, Agrar‑ und Lebensmittelindustrie) sowie die molekulare Onkologie. Das Unternehmen ist in rund 45 Ländern präsent. Konzernumsatz 2024: rund 3,9 Mrd. €.

bullets.text_fr: Revenue 2024 = 3.9 Mds €, focus stratégique sur Microbiologie + immunoessais.
Performance par segment dans le secteur Diagnostics in vitro : trajectoire de croissance organique communiquée à l'occasion des résultats annuels 2024.
Direction générale réaffirme la trajectoire de moyen terme (guidance EBITDA et marge opérationnelle) lors de la publication des résultats annuels FY2024.
Politique de retour aux actionnaires confirmée (dividende et/ou rachat d'actions selon politique groupe).
Environnement macroéconomique européen incertain (inflation, taux d'intérêt, devises) mentionné comme facteur de vigilance.
Pressions concurrentielles et cycles sectoriels (mentionnés dans la section facteurs de risque de l'URD 2024).
Allocation capital : investissements ciblés sur Microbiologie + immunoessais pour renforcer le positionnement long terme.
Décarbonation / ESG : objectifs réaffirmés en ligne avec le cadre réglementaire CSRD et les engagements net-zéro communiqués.
